She stood in front of the class and looked at the {{v:floor}}.
Our teacher said, "Sora is from Busan. Please be nice to her."

prestudy.tagged_body:
On Monday morning, a new student walked {{v:nervously}} into our classroom. Her name was Sora. {{g:Standing at the front of the room|분사구문: ~하면서 (= As she stood at the front of the room)}}, she kept her eyes on the floor {{g:as if she wanted to disappear|as if + 문장: 마치 ~인 것처럼}}. Our teacher introduced her and said, "Sora {{g:has just moved|현재완료(완료): 막 ~했다}} here from Busan, so please do your best to {{g:make her feel welcome|사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형: ~가 …하게 하다}}."
At lunchtime, Sora sat by herself in the corner of the {{v:cafeteria}}. She ate her rice slowly and quietly, without talking to anyone. I really wanted to go over and say hello, but I was {{g:too shy to move|too + 형용사 + to부정사: 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다}}, just like her.
Then a memory of my own first day at this school suddenly came back to me. I had been {{v:terrified}}, and not a single person had spoken to me. It was probably the longest and loneliest day of my life.
Taking a deep breath, I gathered my {{v:courage}} and walked over to her table. "Hi, I'm Yuna. Do you mind if I sit here?" I asked. Sora looked up in surprise, and then a warm smile {{v:spread}} across her face. "Of course not!"
Soon we were chatting about cats, our favorite cartoons, and the snacks we loved most. Today, Sora is my best friend. That day taught me an important lesson: {{t:sometimes a single small hello is enough to change everything}}.

questions.explanation: 'Do you mind ~?'에 'Of course not!'이라고 답하면 '전혀 싫지 않아, 그렇게 해'라는 허락의 뜻이다.

questions.q: Choose the word that best fits the blank: Sora has just ____ here from Busan.
questions.explanation: 현재완료는 'has + 과거분사'이므로 moved가 알맞다.

questions.q: How did Sora's face change when Yuna spoke to her?
questions.explanation: 'Sora looked up in surprise, and then a warm smile spread across her face.'와 일치한다.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: New students should make friends by themselves.
Shy people can never make friends.
Moving to a new city is always exciting.
A small act of kindness can change someone's life.
Lunchtime is the best time to study.
questions.answer: A small act of kindness can change someone's life.
questions.explanation: 'sometimes a single small hello is enough to change everything'이 글의 요지이다.

questions.q: On Monday morning, a new student walked ____ into our classroom.
questions.explanation: 'walked nervously into our classroom'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Please do your best to make her feel ____.
questions.explanation: 'make her feel welcome'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: At lunchtime, Sora sat by herself in the corner of the ____.
questions.explanation: 'in the corner of the cafeteria'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Taking a deep breath, I gathered my ____ and walked over to her table.
questions.explanation: 'I gathered my courage'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Sora looked up in surprise, and then a warm smile ____ across her face.
questions.explanation: 'a warm smile spread across her face'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: No one spoke to Yuna on her first day at this school.
questions.explanation: 'not a single person had spoken to me'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Sora refused to let Yuna sit at her table.
questions.explanation: 'Of course not!'은 앉아도 된다는 뜻이므로 사실이 아니다.

questions.q: Yuna and Sora chatted about cats, cartoons, and snacks.
questions.explanation: 'we were chatting about cats, our favorite cartoons, and the snacks we loved most'와 일치한다.

items: At lunchtime, Sora sat by herself in the corner of the cafeteria.
Soon we were chatting about cats, our favorite cartoons, and the snacks we loved most.
Our teacher introduced her and said, "Sora has just moved here from Busan, so please do your best to make her feel welcome."
Taking a deep breath, I gathered my courage and walked over to her table.
answer: Our teacher introduced her and said, "Sora has just moved here from Busan, so please do your best to make her feel welcome."
At lunchtime, Sora sat by herself in the corner of the cafeteria.
Taking a deep breath, I gathered my courage and walked over to her table.
Soon we were chatting about cats, our favorite cartoons, and the snacks we loved most.

essays.q: Explain in English why Yuna could understand Sora's feelings.
essays.sampleAnswer: Because Yuna had also been terrified and lonely on her first day, when nobody spoke to her.
essays.rubric: 유나 자신도 첫날 무섭고 외로웠으며 아무도 말을 걸지 않았다는 내용이면 만점

essays.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'too ~ to': Yuna was very shy, so she couldn't move.
essays.sampleAnswer: Yuna was too shy to move.
essays.rubric: 'too shy to move' 구조를 정확히 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'Do you mind if I sit here?'에 대한 소라의 대답 'Of course not!'은 무슨 뜻인가요?
essays.sampleAnswer: 전혀 싫지 않으니 앉아도 된다는 뜻이다.
essays.rubric: 앉아도 된다(허락)는 의미를 쓰면 만점. '물론 안 돼'로 해석하면 0점

essays.q: What lesson did Yuna learn that day? Answer in one English sentence.
essays.sampleAnswer: She learned that sometimes a single small hello is enough to change everything.
essays.rubric: 작은 인사(친절)가 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있다는 의미면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 소라가 처음에 몹시 긴장했음을 알 수 있는 표현 두 가지를 본문에서 찾아 그 의미를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 'walked nervously into our classroom'(긴장한 채 교실에 들어왔다), 'kept her eyes on the floor as if she wanted to disappear'(사라지고 싶은 것처럼 바닥만 보았다)
essays.rubric: 표현 두 개를 찾고 각각의 의미를 쓰면 만점, 하나만 쓰면 부분 점수
